a1-tener-chunks.note: Tengo hambre. ¿Comemos? — I am hungry. Shall we eat?. Conjugate tener; hambre does not change with the subject. Say tengo hambre, not soy hambre.

a1-tener-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tenemos ____; queremos agua.
Meaning: We are thirsty; we want water.
a1-tener-chunks.note: Tenemos sed; queremos agua. — We are thirsty; we want water.. Use tener sed when you need a drink. Do not use estar sed.

a1-tener-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tengo ____; voy a dormir.
Meaning: I am sleepy; I am going to sleep.
a1-tener-chunks.note: Tengo sueño; voy a dormir. — I am sleepy; I am going to sleep.. Use it for the need to sleep, not an ambition. Tener un sueño can mean having a dream; the article changes the reading.

a1-tener-chunks.prompt: You have walked in the heat and need water. Explain your need.
a1-tener-chunks.note: Thirst calls for a drink, not food or sleep.
options: Tengo sed.
Tengo hambre.
Tengo sueño.

a1-routine-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Estudio ____.
Meaning: I study in the morning.
a1-routine-chunks.note: Estudio por la mañana. — I study in the morning.. Use this time phrase for a morning routine. Mañana without the article can also mean tomorrow.

a1-routine-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tengo ____; el tren sale pronto.
Meaning: I am in a hurry; the train leaves soon.
a1-routine-chunks.note: Tengo prisa; el tren sale pronto. — I am in a hurry; the train leaves soon.. Conjugate tener to match the person who is rushed. Prisa is the noun; use tengo prisa, not estoy prisa.

a1-routine-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Damos un ____ después de comer.
Meaning: We go for a walk after eating.
a1-routine-chunks.note: Damos un paseo después de comer. — We go for a walk after eating.. Use dar + un paseo for a leisurely walk. Dar changes with the subject: doy, das, da, damos.

a1-routine-chunks.prompt: Your train leaves in five minutes. Explain why you cannot stop to chat.
options: Tengo prisa.
Tengo sueño.
Doy un paseo.

a2-meet-and-plan.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tengo ____ de salir esta tarde.
Meaning: I feel like going out this afternoon.
a2-meet-and-plan.note: Tengo ganas de salir esta tarde. — I feel like going out this afternoon.. Follow de with an infinitive or a noun. Keep de: ganas de salir, not ganas salir.

a2-meet-and-plan.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
¿Te viene ____ el martes?
Meaning: Does Tuesday work for you?
a2-meet-and-plan.note: ¿Te viene bien el martes? — Does Tuesday work for you?. Check whether a time or arrangement is convenient. Venir bien here is convenience, not physical movement.

a2-meet-and-plan.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
He quedado ____ Ana a las seis.
Meaning: I have arranged to meet Ana at six.
a2-meet-and-plan.note: He quedado con Ana a las seis. — I have arranged to meet Ana at six.. Use con for the person; add a time or place. Quedarse means staying; do not add se to this pattern.

a2-meet-and-plan.prompt: You propose meeting at six, but need to check your friend's availability.
a2-meet-and-plan.note: Check whether the time suits the other person.
options: ¿Te viene bien a las seis?
Ya hemos quedado a las seis.
No tengo ganas de verte.

a2-practical-help.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
¿Me puedes ____ con esta maleta?
Meaning: Can you help me with this suitcase?
a2-practical-help.note: ¿Me puedes ayudar con esta maleta? — Can you help me with this suitcase?. Name the task after the request if needed. Use me for helping me; te would mean helping you.

a2-practical-help.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
—Perdón por llegar tarde. —____.
Meaning: —Sorry I am late. —It is okay.
a2-practical-help.note: —Perdón por llegar tarde. —No pasa nada. — —Sorry I am late. —It is okay.. Reassure someone after a minor mistake or inconvenience. Avoid using it to dismiss a serious problem or someone’s feelings.

a2-practical-help.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
—¿Puedo sentarme? —____.
Meaning: —May I sit down? —Of course.
a2-practical-help.note: —¿Puedo sentarme? —Por supuesto. — —May I sit down? —Of course.. Give a confident yes; tone can make it sound warm or impatient. It expresses certainty or agreement, not a guess.

a2-practical-help.prompt: A friend apologises for being two minutes late. Reassure them.
a2-practical-help.note: No pasa nada reassures someone after a small problem.
options: No pasa nada.
¿Me puedes ayudar?
No vuelvas nunca.

a2-time-patterns.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
____ cocino con mis amigos.
Meaning: From time to time I cook with my friends.
a2-time-patterns.note: De vez en cuando cocino con mis amigos. — From time to time I cook with my friends.. Use it for an occasional event, not a daily obligation. Keep the whole sequence de vez en cuando.

a2-time-patterns.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Llegamos a ____ para el tren.
Meaning: We arrived in time for the train.
a2-time-patterns.note: Llegamos a tiempo para el tren. — We arrived in time for the train.. Use it when arrival is early enough for the event. Use a tiempo; por tiempo is not this expression.

a2-time-patterns.prompt:
Rebuild the model for: “I have been studying Spanish for two months.”
Begin with “Llevo”.
a2-time-patterns.note: Llevo dos meses estudiando español. — I have been studying Spanish for two months.. Conjugate llevar and put the activity in the gerund. Use estudiando, not estudiar, in this pattern.

a2-time-patterns.prompt: You visit that café occasionally, with no fixed schedule. Describe the habit.
a2-time-patterns.note: De vez en cuando indicates occasional frequency.
options: Voy de vez en cuando.
Voy todos los días.
Nunca voy.

a2-experience-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Lo pasamos ____ en la fiesta.
Meaning: We had a good time at the party.
a2-experience-chunks.note: Lo pasamos bien en la fiesta. — We had a good time at the party.. Conjugate pasar; pasarlo bien is common in Spain, pasarla bien in many American varieties. The lo/la choice varies regionally; neither is a universal correction of the other.

a2-experience-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Quiero ____.
Meaning: I want to ask a question.
a2-experience-chunks.note: Quiero hacer una pregunta. — I want to ask a question.. Use hacer with una pregunta. Preguntar is also correct, but not pedir una pregunta for asking one.

a2-experience-chunks.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Cometí un ____ en la dirección.
Meaning: I made an error in the address.
a2-experience-chunks.note: Cometí un error en la dirección. — I made an error in the address.. Use cometer for an error; equivocarse is another natural option. Hacer un error is not the usual combination.

a2-experience-chunks.prompt: You enjoyed a party. Tell the host how it went for you.
a2-experience-chunks.note: Pasarlo bien describes enjoying an experience.
options: Lo pasé muy bien.
Cometí un error.
Quiero hacer una pregunta.

b1-clarify-and-add.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Dices que es complicado. ____
Meaning: You say it is complicated. What do you mean?
b1-clarify-and-add.note: Dices que es complicado. ¿A qué te refieres? — You say it is complicated. What do you mean?. Ask the speaker to clarify their intended reference. Referirse uses a: me refiero a eso.

b1-clarify-and-add.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Trabaja de noche, ____, empieza a las diez.
Meaning: She works at night; that is, she starts at ten.
b1-clarify-and-add.note: Trabaja de noche, es decir, empieza a las diez. — She works at night; that is, she starts at ten.. Restate an idea more precisely. It reformulates; it does not normally introduce an unrelated topic.

b1-clarify-and-add.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
____, ¿cómo fue tu entrevista?
Meaning: By the way, how did your interview go?
b1-clarify-and-add.note: Por cierto, ¿cómo fue tu entrevista? — By the way, how did your interview go?. Introduce a related aside or a new small topic. Not the same as por supuesto, which means of course.

b1-clarify-and-add.prompt: You want to explain the same point in simpler words. Choose the connector.
b1-clarify-and-add.note: Es decir introduces reformulation; por cierto changes topic.
options: Es decir, necesitamos más tiempo.
Por cierto, compré una bicicleta.
Sin embargo, nos sobra tiempo.

b1-opinion-partners.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Estoy de acuerdo ____ tu propuesta.
Meaning: I agree with your proposal.
b1-opinion-partners.note: Estoy de acuerdo con tu propuesta. — I agree with your proposal.. Use con before a person or idea. Use estar, not ser, and keep de.

b1-opinion-partners.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tienes ____: el museo cierra los lunes.
Meaning: You are right: the museum closes on Mondays.
b1-opinion-partners.note: Tienes razón: el museo cierra los lunes. — You are right: the museum closes on Mondays.. Recognise that someone’s statement or argument is correct. It is tener razón, not ser razón.

b1-opinion-partners.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Vamos en tren ____ conducir.
Meaning: We are going by train instead of driving.
b1-opinion-partners.note: Vamos en tren en vez de conducir. — We are going by train instead of driving.. Introduce the replaced option using a noun or infinitive. Keep de before the infinitive.

b1-opinion-partners.prompt: The printer is broken. Propose emailing the document as a substitute.
b1-opinion-partners.note: En vez de replaces the original action.
options: Enviémoslo por correo en vez de imprimirlo.
Enviémoslo después de imprimirlo.
Imprimámoslo antes de enviarlo.

b1-help-idioms.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
¿Me echas una ____ con las cajas?
Meaning: Can you give me a hand with the boxes?
b1-help-idioms.note: ¿Me echas una mano con las cajas? — Can you give me a hand with the boxes?. Add a person with an indirect object: ¿me echas una mano? Echar has no h; hechar is a spelling error.

b1-help-idioms.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Voy a ____ al horario.
Meaning: I am going to take a quick look at the timetable.
b1-help-idioms.note: Voy a echar un vistazo al horario. — I am going to take a quick look at the timetable.. Use a before what you look at. It suggests a brief look, not necessarily a detailed review.

b1-help-idioms.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Para Ana, este ejercicio es pan ____.
Meaning: For Ana, this exercise is a piece of cake.
b1-help-idioms.note: Para Ana, este ejercicio es pan comido. — For Ana, this exercise is a piece of cake.. Describe a task that feels easy to the speaker. Avoid it if it would belittle another person’s genuine difficulty.

b1-help-idioms.prompt: A friend is struggling to carry a box. Offer help.
options: ¿Te echo una mano con la caja?
¿Le echo un vistazo al horario?
¿Te llevas bien con tu vecino?

b1-reaction-patterns.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Me di ____ de que faltaba una página.
Meaning: I realised that a page was missing.
b1-reaction-patterns.note: Me di cuenta de que faltaba una página. — I realised that a page was missing.. Use a reflexive pronoun and de, including before que. Keep de que: darse cuenta de que, not darse cuenta que in careful usage.

b1-reaction-patterns.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
El problema tiene que ver ____ el horario.
Meaning: The problem has to do with the timetable.
b1-reaction-patterns.note: El problema tiene que ver con el horario. — The problem has to do with the timetable.. Use con to introduce the related topic. This does not mean you are obliged to look at something.

b1-reaction-patterns.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Me llevo bien ____ mis compañeros.
Meaning: I get along well with my colleagues.
b1-reaction-patterns.note: Me llevo bien con mis compañeros. — I get along well with my colleagues.. Use the reflexive pronoun and con before the person. Llevar bien without se does not express this relationship in the same way.

b1-reaction-patterns.prompt: You just noticed the meeting was moved to tomorrow. Report your realisation.
b1-reaction-patterns.note: Darse cuenta de marks becoming aware.
options: Me acabo de dar cuenta de que la reunión es mañana.
Siempre he sabido que era mañana.
Me llevo bien con los asistentes.

b2-decide-and-weigh.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Hay que ____ el coste total.
Meaning: We need to take the total cost into account.
b2-decide-and-weigh.note: Hay que tener en cuenta el coste total. — We need to take the total cost into account.. Use it with a factor that should influence the decision. It concerns consideration, not merely counting numbers.

b2-decide-and-weigh.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tomaremos una ____ después de comparar las ofertas.
Meaning: We will make a decision after comparing the offers.
b2-decide-and-weigh.note: Tomaremos una decisión después de comparar las ofertas. — We will make a decision after comparing the offers.. Use tomar with una decisión; decidir is a concise alternative. Do not translate English make mechanically as hacer here.

b2-decide-and-weigh.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Vale la ____ comparar las opciones.
Meaning: It is worth comparing the options.
b2-decide-and-weigh.note: Vale la pena comparar las opciones. — It is worth comparing the options.. Follow it with an infinitive, or que + subjunctive. It need not involve literal pain or punishment.

b2-decide-and-weigh.prompt: A flat is cheap but far from work. Add the missing consideration.
b2-decide-and-weigh.note: Tener en cuenta includes a relevant factor in a decision.
options: Tenemos que tener en cuenta el tiempo de viaje.
Solo importa el precio.
Ya no hay nada que considerar.

b2-collaborate.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tenemos que ponernos de ____ sobre la fecha.
Meaning: We need to agree on the date.
b2-collaborate.note: Tenemos que ponernos de acuerdo sobre la fecha. — We need to agree on the date.. Describe the process of agreeing; estar de acuerdo describes the state. Match the reflexive pronoun: nos ponemos, not se ponemos.

b2-collaborate.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
El equipo llevará a ____ una prueba.
Meaning: The team will carry out a test.
b2-collaborate.note: El equipo llevará a cabo una prueba. — The team will carry out a test.. Use it with a task, plan or investigation. Keep a; llevar cabo omits part of the expression.

b2-collaborate.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Debemos ____ los nuevos gastos.
Meaning: We must deal with the new expenses.
b2-collaborate.note: Debemos hacer frente a los nuevos gastos. — We must deal with the new expenses.. Use a before the challenge or expense. It does not necessarily mean a physical confrontation.

b2-collaborate.prompt: A plan has been agreed. Tell the team to implement it.
b2-collaborate.note: Llevar a cabo means to carry out.
options: Ahora vamos a llevar a cabo el plan.
Ahora vamos a cancelar el plan.
Todavía no sabemos si necesitamos un plan.

b2-idioms-pressure.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Metí la ____ al mencionar la fiesta sorpresa.
Meaning: I put my foot in it by mentioning the surprise party.
b2-idioms-pressure.note: Metí la pata al mencionar la fiesta sorpresa. — I put my foot in it by mentioning the surprise party.. Use it for an awkward mistake, especially something said or done socially. In a formal apology, cometí un error is usually safer.

b2-idioms-pressure.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
No oyó la pregunta; estaba en las ____.
Meaning: She did not hear the question; she was daydreaming.
b2-idioms-pressure.note: No oyó la pregunta; estaba en las nubes. — She did not hear the question; she was daydreaming.. Describe someone not paying attention. It is not necessarily a description of happiness.

b2-idioms-pressure.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Con un trámite sencillo ya se ahoga en un vaso de ____.
Meaning: Even a simple administrative task overwhelms him.
b2-idioms-pressure.note: Con un trámite sencillo ya se ahoga en un vaso de agua. — Even a simple administrative task overwhelms him.. Describes a disproportionate reaction from the speaker’s perspective. It can sound belittling; do not use it to dismiss distress.

b2-idioms-pressure.prompt: You accidentally mention a surprise party to its guest of honour. Admit the social mistake.
b2-idioms-pressure.note: Meter la pata describes a blunder.
options: He metido la pata.
Estoy en las nubes.
Me llevo bien con todo el mundo.

b2-idioms-effort.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Ese hotel cuesta un ojo de la ____.
Meaning: That hotel costs a fortune.
b2-idioms-effort.note: Ese hotel cuesta un ojo de la cara. — That hotel costs a fortune.. Express a subjective judgement that something is very expensive. It is exaggeration, not a precise price.

b2-idioms-effort.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Aún no voy a ____.
Meaning: I am not going to give up yet.
b2-idioms-effort.note: Aún no voy a tirar la toalla. — I am not going to give up yet.. Often appears with no to encourage persistence. Do not interpret toalla as actual laundry in this context.

b2-idioms-effort.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Tenemos que ponernos las ____ antes del examen.
Meaning: We need to get focused and work hard before the exam.
b2-idioms-effort.note: Tenemos que ponernos las pilas antes del examen. — We need to get focused and work hard before the exam.. Urges someone to become more active or attentive. As a command it can sound pushy; use with care.

b2-idioms-effort.prompt: You failed the first attempt but intend to continue. Tell a friend.
b2-idioms-effort.note: Not throwing in the towel signals persistence.
options: No voy a tirar la toalla.
Ya he tirado la toalla.
Me cuesta un ojo de la cara.

c1-evidence-collocations.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
El informe pone de ____ la falta de recursos.
Meaning: The report reveals the lack of resources.
c1-evidence-collocations.note: El informe pone de manifiesto la falta de recursos. — The report reveals the lack of resources.. Introduce what an observation clearly demonstrates or exposes. It makes a strong evidential claim; do not use it for a mere guess.

c1-evidence-collocations.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Los nuevos datos ponen en tela de ____ esa conclusión.
Meaning: The new data call that conclusion into question.
c1-evidence-collocations.note: Los nuevos datos ponen en tela de juicio esa conclusión. — The new data call that conclusion into question.. Question the validity or reliability of a claim. Questioning is not automatically disproving.

c1-evidence-collocations.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
____ los resultados, conviene revisar el plan.
Meaning: In light of the results, it is advisable to review the plan.
c1-evidence-collocations.note: A la luz de los resultados, conviene revisar el plan. — In light of the results, it is advisable to review the plan.. Frame a judgement in relation to relevant evidence or developments. The phrase identifies a basis; it does not establish causation by itself.

c1-evidence-collocations.prompt: New evidence undermines an earlier conclusion. Describe its effect cautiously.
c1-evidence-collocations.note: Putting a conclusion in question is different from proving it false or confirming it.
options: Los datos ponen en tela de juicio la conclusión anterior.
Los datos confirman definitivamente la conclusión.
Los datos no tienen ninguna relación con la conclusión.

c1-qualify-arguments.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
____l coste, faltan datos.
Meaning: As regards the cost, data are missing.
c1-qualify-arguments.note: En lo que respecta al coste, faltan datos. — As regards the cost, data are missing.. Introduce the particular aspect you are discussing. A + el becomes al; this phrase does not introduce a cause.

c1-qualify-arguments.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Explicaré el proyecto ____.
Meaning: I will explain the project in broad outline.
c1-qualify-arguments.note: Explicaré el proyecto a grandes rasgos. — I will explain the project in broad outline.. Give an overview while deliberately omitting detail. Do not promise a detailed specification with this phrase.

c1-qualify-arguments.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Estoy de acuerdo, ____.
Meaning: I agree, to a certain extent.
c1-qualify-arguments.note: Estoy de acuerdo, hasta cierto punto. — I agree, to a certain extent.. Limit the scope of agreement or validity. It qualifies agreement rather than rejecting everything.

c1-qualify-arguments.prompt: You agree with part of an argument, but not all of it. Qualify your agreement.
c1-qualify-arguments.note: Hasta cierto punto limits the extent of agreement.
options: Estoy de acuerdo hasta cierto punto.
Estoy totalmente de acuerdo sin reservas.
No estoy de acuerdo en absoluto.

c1-read-subtext.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Al ____, percibí una reserva en su respuesta.
Meaning: Reading between the lines, I sensed a reservation in her reply.
c1-read-subtext.note: Al leer entre líneas, percibí una reserva en su respuesta. — Reading between the lines, I sensed a reservation in her reply.. Interpret suggestions that are not stated directly. An inference is not proof of the speaker’s hidden intention.

c1-read-subtext.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Le preguntaron por el plazo, pero se fue por las ____.
Meaning: They asked about the deadline, but he went off on a tangent.
c1-read-subtext.note: Le preguntaron por el plazo, pero se fue por las ramas. — They asked about the deadline, but he went off on a tangent.. Describe a reply that wanders away from the central issue. It may suggest avoidance, but not necessarily deliberate deception.

c1-read-subtext.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Está en ____ la confianza de los clientes.
Meaning: The customers’ trust is at stake.
c1-read-subtext.note: Está en juego la confianza de los clientes. — The customers’ trust is at stake.. Identify something that may be gained, lost or damaged. This can describe a serious risk, not a recreational game.

c1-read-subtext.prompt: A speaker keeps giving irrelevant details instead of answering. Ask them to be direct.
c1-read-subtext.note: Irse por las ramas describes avoiding the central point.
options: Por favor, no te vayas por las ramas.
Por favor, lee entre líneas.
Por favor, echa una mano.

c1-register-shift.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
Con ese diagnóstico, has dado en el ____.
Meaning: With that diagnosis, you have hit the nail on the head.
c1-register-shift.note: Con ese diagnóstico, has dado en el clavo. — With that diagnosis, you have hit the nail on the head.. Praise an accurate diagnosis or observation. For a formal report, describe exactly what the diagnosis identified.

c1-register-shift.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
El análisis pasó por ____ un factor importante.
Meaning: The analysis overlooked an important factor.
c1-register-shift.note: El análisis pasó por alto un factor importante. — The analysis overlooked an important factor.. Describe failing to notice or deliberately not addressing something. Context determines whether the omission was intentional.

c1-register-shift.prompt:
Complete the model with the lesson's wording.
El acuerdo sienta las ____ de una colaboración duradera.
Meaning: The agreement lays the foundations for lasting collaboration.
c1-register-shift.note: El acuerdo sienta las bases de una colaboración duradera. — The agreement lays the foundations for lasting collaboration.. Describe creating conditions for later development. Foundations enable later work; they do not guarantee success.

c1-register-shift.prompt: A colleague's analysis identifies the exact problem. Praise its accuracy conversationally.
c1-register-shift.note: Dar en el clavo means to identify something exactly.
options: Has dado en el clavo.
Has pasado por alto el problema.
Te has ido por las ramas.
